integrity: All theoretical assertions are proved analytically in RESULT.md; five finite independent numerical integrations are corroborative and not claimed as an infinite proof. Extremality is explicitly attributed to Hynd.
scientific_limitations: Asymptotic only for regular odd-n Reuleaux polygons revolved about a reflection axis. No general stability theorem for all extreme bodies, no monotonicity, no next coefficient. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Sharp volume-deficit asymptotics for extremal Reuleaux solids of revolution
